ov: White or buff herons with long legs that grow fine, milky-white plumes in the breeding season. There is no clear line between egrets and herons. They live on every continent, in fresh and salt-water marshes. The great egret has a yellow bill and black legs.
rg: Every continent, avoiding the coldest regions, deserts and high mountains.
df: Mainly fish, frogs and other amphibians, mice, snakes, crayfish and water insects (great egret).
fx: The word egret comes from the French aigrette, meaning both "silver heron" and "brush".
Great egrets nest in colonies in trees close to water.
